units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 7:1:3">Y. Dem. VII, 26ᵃ</cite> <he>מקל ב׳</he> (not <cite ref="M01285"><he>מיקל</he></cite>) the commissioner’s pointed staff (with which he searches). Y’lamd. to Gen. XXXVIII, 1 quot. in Ar. <he>בלשיי מסר וכ׳</he> the constable delivers the prisoner over to the executioner.—Pl. <cite ref="B00919"><he>בַּלְשִׁין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 15:4">Kel. XV, 4</cite> <he>מקל הב׳</he>, v. supra.—<he>בַּלְשִׁיִּין</he>. Y’lamd. to Num. XXIII, 7. [Var. in Hai Gaon <he>בַּלְסַיי</he>.]
